capabilities: Split a note into new notes at each occurrence of a delimiter
Set the output folder for split notes
Use the first line of split content as the note title
Append text to each split note
Optionally delete the original note after splitting
extras: Desktop only; the original note is never modified unless 'Delete original' is enabled. The README's Learn more section points to a community workflow creating Anki flashcards with Yanki and ChatGPT.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to automatically break one long note into many separate notes using a custom separator.
summary: Note splitter that divides a single note into multiple new notes based on a chosen delimiter, saving the results to a configurable output folder.
